canon.summary: A bio-forged war-boar the size of a truck, plated in ablative tusk-steel and fitted with surplus booster rockets by a pit crew who thought it would be funny. It was. Razorback knows exactly one tactic — forward — and executes it with the sincerity of an avalanche. He has never once retreated, mostly because nobody has taught him the concept.

primarySources.note: Studio origin document: bio-forge program, the rocket retrofit, pit-crew adoption, zero-retreat temperament.
Kit design: quadruped bruiser, charge identity, counter-attack tusks, energy overload and psychic simplicity as counters.

canon.selectedInterpretation: Season 0 baseline Razorback — an armored charge specialist, not an unstoppable projectile.
assumptions: The booster rockets are dumb solid-fuel units on a mechanical timer; they cannot be hacked, only survived.

powerSources.name: tusk_steel_and_rockets
powerSources.origin: Bio-forged muscle and bone under ablative plate, plus strap-on solid-fuel boosters
interruptionConditions: energy weapons overload the ablative plate's dissipation mesh
his simple mind takes psychic assault poorly

limitations.description: One gear: forward. He cannot disengage, feint, or hold position with any conviction.
Turns like a truck — agile enemies who sidestep the charge get free hits on his flanks.

weaknessSummary.description: Energy fire overloads the ablative mesh and cooks the muscle beneath the plate.
A simple, trusting mind — psychic attack finds no defenses at all.

behaviorSummary.combatIntelligence: Low cunning, superb instinct — he reads momentum and mass the way tacticians read maps.
behaviorSummary.tacticalStyle: Charge the biggest thing, gore it, trample whatever gathers, repeat until the arena is quiet.
behaviorSummary.riskTolerance: Total — the concept of losing has never been successfully explained to him.
behaviorSummary.allyProtection: Incidental — teammates learn to fight in the wake he clears.
moralConstraints: Stops goring anything that stops moving
commandConstraints: Physically incapable of honoring a retreat order
Ignores his own injuries when choosing to attack

claims.selectedValue: rocket-assisted charge covering ~12 m in a burst
amplified damage from energy weapons via plate overload

aiAssumptions: Rocket charge modeled as a movement ability rather than a damaging dash, with tusk damage arriving via follow-up strikes
mechanicalNormalizations: Trample bounded to a 5 m shockwave rather than a full lane of destruction

foundational.name: Tusk Swipe
foundational.description: A sideways rake of the head. For Razorback this is a friendly greeting.

signature.name: Rocket Charge
signature.description: The boosters light, the arena shrinks, and the distance between Razorback and his problem stops existing.

signature.name: Gore Toss
signature.description: Tusks under, neck up — whatever he hits spends a moment airborne reconsidering its draft position.

signature.name: Trample Burst
signature.description: He bucks and slams all four hooves down — the misfiring rockets spray shrapnel and shockwave in a ring.

signature.name: Tusk Rend
signature.description: A grinding twist of both tusks that peels armor open for everything that follows.

escalation.name: Final Stampede
escalation.description: Every remaining rocket fires at once. Witnesses describe it as weather.

passives.name: Reflex Gore
passives.description: Hit him up close and the tusks answer before the brain is consulted.

weaknesses.description: Energy fire saturates the ablative mesh — past its limit, every bolt cooks straight through to muscle.
There are no locked doors in Razorback's head. Psychic attacks walk right in.

behavior.personality: Cheerfully unstoppable — an avalanche that loves its job.

synergies.description: Another beast on the field wakes something pack-shaped in him.

balance.priceRationale: elite raw combat output, dependable in any conditions increased the price. Scores — capability 71, versatility 63, reliability 87, counterability 36.

presentation.silhouette: Truck-sized armored boar, chipped steel tusks, twin booster rockets strapped over the haunches

knownIssues: Balance: below-band self-play win rate; melee approach tax under investigation (systemic, shared with ember-ronin).
